sar.narrative: This report details suspicious online activity involving card C13487-K1 and multiple other accounts. Between November 15, 2016, and November 22, 2016, two online transactions totaling $187.33 were conducted on card C13487-K1 in region 191. These transactions were initiated using a specific Samsung device profile (ID D004630, SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) operating behind an anonymous proxy. The device was marked as new to the account at the time of the transactions. Graph analysis reveals this same device profile has been used across 21 different cards recently, always as a new device and behind a proxy. Furthermore, the device is part of a known fraud ring (ID 36700632) connected to seven other cards (including C02975-K1, C06617-K1, and C12645-K1) with confirmed fraud. Four prior closed cases of confirmed fraud are also linked to this device, showing a consistent pattern of undocumented abuse. The coordinated use of a single device and proxy across dozens of unrelated accounts indicates a systematic compromise. The total exposure for the flagged card is $187.33.

stop_reason: The investigation stopped because the fraud probability reached 0.99, which is decisive under Section 6, supported by multiple independent pieces of evidence including a shared device behind a proxy, links to a known fraud ring, and prior confirmed fraud cases.
